'''Janusz Andrzej Pęcherz''' (born 6 November 1954) is a Polish politician. He was elected to the [[9th term Sejm and 10th term Senate of Poland|Senate of Poland]] (10th term) representing the constituency of Kalisz. He graduated from the Faculty of Chemistry at the Lodz University of Technology. In 2002, he was elected president of Kalisz. In the 2006 local government elections, he successfully ran for re-election, running with the support of several local parties and winning the first round. In 2010, he again won the third term in the first round with about 51% of the vote. In 2014, he was not re-elected for another term. In 2018, he was appointed a city councilor in Kalisz, and then became the head of the city council.<ref name="senate_poland_profile">{{Cite web|title=Janusz Pęcherz|url=https://www.senat.gov.pl/sklad/senatorowie/senator,975,10,janusz-pecherz.html|access-date=21 February 2021|website=Senate of Poland|language=pl}}</ref><ref name="essential_stats_tenth_term_senate_poland_2019">{{Cite web|title=Essential statistics about the Senate of the Tenth Term|url=https://www.senat.gov.pl/gfx/senat/userfiles/_public/k10eng/noty2020/09_10.pdf|url-status=live|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210221180724/https://www.senat.gov.pl/gfx/senat/userfiles/_public/k10eng/noty2020/09_10.pdf|archive-date=21 February 2021|access-date=21 February 2021|website=Senate of Poland}}</ref>

He was also elected to the [[10th term Sejm and 11th term Senate of Poland|11th term]] of the Senate of Poland.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Essential statistics about the Senate of the Eleventh Term |url=https://www.senat.gov.pl/gfx/senat/userfiles/_public/k11eng/noty/04/09_04_24_en.pdf |access-date=10 October 2024 |website=Senate of Poland }}{{Dead link|date=October 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}</ref>
